agent.problem: The question places God's command to transfer Aaron's garments up on Mount Hor, as though God speaks after the men have climbed. Numbers 20:25-27 gives the command first, and only then says that Moses obeyed and they climbed the mountain.

rule.text: Retelling: Papa Dorin can retell in his own words and fill in what the text clearly implies. Scene-setting details are fine. He never says anything the text shows is wrong.
